Wan Wan Wan Project : Year 8
In 2024 , our focus was on restoring herbal cultivation areas that were 
affected by the floods in late 2023 . The project ’s total accumulated income 
returned to local communities has reached 866,089 Baht.
Launched in 2016, the project supports local communities through aloe vera 
cultivation. SAPPE provides plant seedlings, technical knowledge, and 
ongoing guidance, while purchasing harvested aloe vera to ensure stable 
income and improved livelihoods.2024 SOCIAL PERFORMANCE
